content.comment_body: Hello, I am interested in controlling several relays (Shelly 1 Gen 4) through LAN or WLAN. According to the documentation, Modbus is available as an RPC option: [url]. Is it possible to send a get request, and if so, how many relays can be connected and managed?
Please avoid posting the same question multiple times. You have asked the same thing in a different thread: switch Shelly 1 Gen4 Relais over LAN / WLAN.
This topic has been closed due to duplicate postings. For ongoing discussion, please refer to the link provided above. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is seeking advice on controlling multiple third-party Shelly relays via LAN/WLAN using Modbus RPC, including protocol compatibility and device connection limits. No [company_name] products were reviewed in this thread. Moderation closed the discussion quickly due to duplicate posts, so no detailed findings or user feedback on [company_name] solutions were provided.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to utilize Modbus RPC to send requests to Shelly 1 Gen 4 relays through a LAN or WLAN connection and is seeking information about the maximum number of relays that can be connected and managed with this approach.
